notes.title: Mini Patch #5
notes.content:
One tweak and language support.


    Added Russian language support with the help from Kein Zantezuken
    Transitional level now shows the check mark on the new level first tile if perfected


Seek Etyliv

notes.title: Mini Patch #4
notes.content:
Another batch of tweaks.


    Added Chinese language support with the help from Project Gutenberg
    Updated controller behaviour:
    
        Analog stick movement advances text
        L3 handles select
        L1 and R1 handle back
        Right analog stick can be used for movement
    


Seek Etyliv

notes.title: Mini Patch #3
notes.content:
Generally invisible updates.


Dots no longer extend past the frame boundaries
Added SteamOS version 
Added Windows 32-bit version
Lithuanian language offsets are corrected


Seek Etyliv

notes.title: Mini Patch #2
notes.content:
This one improves the gameplay.


    The Tourist unlock condition difficulty tweaked to reflect what was intended initially
    Dungeon levels completed in minimal number of moves show a tick mark
    Game reduces CPU devouring when not in focus
    Wings can't be skipped in that one level anymore
    The Plastic and The Confused unlock Steam achievements without restart


As usual, report unusual behaviour and get it patched.

Seek Etyliv

notes.title: Mini Patch #1
notes.content:
The first game patch is now up. It primarily addresses the dungeon issues.


    On failing a dungeon, you go back to restarting it with the current character instead of entering the graveyard
    Chances to encounter levels you've solved are significantly reduced, slightly less so for failed levels, making levels appear as often as others
    Same applies to the dungeon layouts
    Tiles of icons, with which you've completed the dungeon are now different


If you encounter more bugs and / or frustrating design, let me know either in the community posts or on twitter (@rokasvo) and I'll do my best to address them.

Seek Etyliv
